questions.question: Define a loss and give three possible causes of a loss in a small business.
questions.expected_answer: A loss occurs when expenses are greater than income for a period. Causes (any three): low sales; prices too low; high costs; waste of stock; theft; unexpected events such as load-shedding or floods.

questions.question: What is a budget and give two reasons why households and businesses should budget.
questions.expected_answer: A plan of expected income and spending for a future period. Reasons (any two): ensures needs are paid before wants; shows shortfalls in advance; helps save for goals; allows comparison of actual with planned spending.

questions.question: Explain what a financial transaction and a source document are, and give two reasons for keeping financial records.
questions.expected_answer: Transaction: any exchange of money or money's worth, e.g. buying stock, selling goods, paying wages. Source document: proof of a transaction with its details, e.g. receipt, invoice, till slip, cheque counterfoil. Reasons (any two): calculate profit/loss; know where money went; make decisions; proof for tax/loans; detect errors and theft.
